identity.title: Exact semidefinite complexity of the symmetric traveling-salesman polytope

targets.native_description_whole: The exponential real PSD-rank theorem for shifted perfect-matching matrices in the OpenAI Math Release implies that the symmetric traveling-salesman polytope on N cities has exact real semidefinite extension complexity 2^Theta(N), measured by the order of one real PSD matrix (or total block order). This concise consequence note gives explicit data for Yannakakis's established 3n-city face projection, a 2n-city contraction variant, all-city-count padding, an exact affine-slack calculation, and the subset-state flow upper bound 2(N-1)+(N-1)(N-2)2^(N-3). The lower-bound breakthrough is attributed to OpenAI; no new lower-bound method or firstness claim is made. Independent mathematical audits examined the central matching proof and found no material defect. The supplied Lean statements cover only superpolynomial matching bounds; neither the exponential input nor this follow-on theorem is claimed to be formally verified. The deposit includes a separately downloadable PDF, standalone source, and reproducible finite checks with audit and dependency records. AI tools were used extensively in research, drafting and verification. This preprint has not undergone conventional human peer review or refereeing; automated reviews are not human peer review. Exact real lifts only; no approximate-relaxation, hierarchy-specific or P-versus-NP assertion.

identity.title: A counterexample to Takao's self-duality question

targets.native_description_whole:
For every prime p greater than 3 and every n at least 3, this research note constructs a finite flat commutative group scheme over W(closure of F_p), killed by p and of rank p^(2n), with quasi-supersingular special fiber, such that both the special fiber and its Witt-ring lift fail Cartier self-duality. It gives an explicit negative answer to the higher-rank question following Proposition 2 on page 2479 of Naotake Takao's contribution to Oberwolfach Report 42/2023.

The proof uses an explicit six-dimensional Dieudonne module, a supersingular elliptic p-torsion filtration, an image-intersection invariant and a finite Honda complement. These are applications of established Dieudonne and finite Honda theory, with the classical cyclic-word framework credited. No first-discovery or first-priority claim is made. The verification supplement includes portable standard-library controls, source references, the bounded priority audit and its access/version limitations.

This is an unrefereed preprint. AI tools were used extensively in solving, verification, literature research, writing, computation and adversarial review. Those automated reviews are not independent external human peer review; no such human review is claimed.

targets.native_description_whole: For an arbitrary antimorphic involution theta, a finite word with alternating theta-periods p and q and length at least p+q-gcd(p,q) has alternating theta-period gcd(p,q). This proves the exact unnumbered conjecture after Theorem 23 on printed page 2220 of Nowotka's contribution, joint with Bischoff, to the 2010 Oberwolfach mini-workshop on combinatorics on words. The common finite extension theta(w)w has ordinary periods 2p and 2q; classical Fine-Wilf and central reflection give the alternating conclusion. A reversal example shows that the sufficient formula cannot be reduced by one uniformly; pairwise optimality is not asserted. The research note credits Fine and Wilf, the originating report and Bischoff's thesis, and compares the related Czeizler-Kari-Seki, Kari-Seki and Simpson results. A portable verification supplement preserves the submitted proof, three independent adversarial mathematical audits, complete finite-control outputs and a dated bounded priority audit. No earlier exact theorem was found in the inspected primary sources, without a global novelty or first-discovery certificate; access and version gaps are explicit. AI tools were used extensively in solving, verification, literature research, writing, computation and adversarial review. This is an unrefereed research note and has not received independent external human peer review.
